sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B official model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the post-trained dense vision-language model, nominal 27B language-model size, 64-layer hybrid layout, native 262,144-token context, image/video understanding and controllable thinking.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 official repository and release news
sources.evidence: Names Alibaba as the developer; explicitly dates Qwen3.8-27B availability on Hugging Face and ModelScope to 2026-08-14. Serving examples enable reasoning and tool-call parsers for this exact checkpoint.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B LICENSE
sources.evidence: The checkpoint is released under Apache License 2.0.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration includes a vision encoder and a dense 64-layer text model with a repeating three-linear/one-full attention pattern, max_position_embeddings 262144, untied embeddings and one MTP layer. No quantization configuration is present.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B chat template
sources.evidence: Explicitly handles image/video/text content, optional thinking with reasoning_effort, function definitions, assistant tool calls and tool responses.

sources.title: Pinned original BF16 checkpoint index and its 18 referenced tensor headers
sources.evidence: Fetched index and HTTP byte ranges containing only the headers of all 18 shards at revision 1d4bf0f2ff6012fd82039f2fa52739d0dd7c60c0. All 1,199 indexed tensors matched exactly and contain 27,781,427,952 BF16 elements: language-model backbone 25,624,600,064; output head 1,271,398,400; vision 460,730,096; MTP 424,699,392. No scale, packed-weight or buffer tensors were found. Index payload size is 55,562,855,904 bytes.

sources.title: Hugging Face metadata for the official Qwen checkpoint
sources.evidence: At access, main resolves to 1d4bf0f2ff6012fd82039f2fa52739d0dd7c60c0; safetensors metadata independently reports 27,781,427,952 BF16 elements. API read directly over HTTPS.

sources.title: Qwen3.5 dense architecture implementation used by Qwen3.8-27B
sources.evidence: The only checkpoint tensor names lacking weight/bias suffixes, A_log and dt_bias, are nn.Parameter objects. Rotary frequencies are nonpersistent buffers and do not appear in the checkpoint.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next official comparison table
sources.evidence: The official Language benchmark table explicitly lists Qwen3.8-27B at 27B activated parameters. This is a developer-reported nominal language-model active count, not an inference from dense architecture or a full vision/MTP count.

name.note: Display spacing represents the official Qwen3.8-27B identifier.

developer.note: Developed by the Qwen team at Alibaba Group.

family.note: Qwen3.8 belongs to the Qwen model family.

release_date.note: Official news explicitly dates release of this exact 27B checkpoint; the 2.4T variant has a separate August 12 release.

open_weights.note: Official downloadable checkpoint is available in 18 safetensors shards.

license.note: Confirmed from the license distributed with this exact checkpoint.

parameters_b.note: Complete learned checkpoint count in decimal billions, including vision and MTP; nominal 27B in the card labels the language-model component. Summed tensor shapes, checked all keys/dtypes, and verified unusual tensor names are parameters; did not treat quantization metadata or buffers as parameters.

active_parameters_b.note: Explicit nominal active count in the exact-model column of the first-party Language comparison table. Scoped to language_model; not a measured vision/MTP-inclusive execution count.

architecture.note: Dense FFNs; hybrid attention with three Gated DeltaNet layers followed by one gated full-attention layer, repeated 16 times, plus a vision encoder.

context_window.note: Native checkpoint context. The card separately documents extension to 1,000,000 tokens; that is not the configured native limit.

modalities.note: Vision encoder and image/video template support with causal text generation.

reasoning.note: Thinking is enabled by default and can be disabled; reasoning effort is configurable.

tool_call.note: Official serving command and native chat template explicitly support function calling.

description.value: Dense Qwen3.8 vision-language model with hybrid Gated DeltaNet and gated attention, configurable reasoning, and tool calling.
description.note: Factual architecture and capabilities; avoids presenting nominal 27B as an exact full-checkpoint count.

patch.description: Dense Qwen3.8 vision-language model with hybrid Gated DeltaNet and gated attention, configurable reasoning, and tool calling.
patch.notes: Complete BF16 checkpoint: 27.781427952B parameters, including 26.895998464B language model plus output head, 0.460730096B vision, and 0.424699392B MTP. The published 27B is nominal. A later official comparison table explicitly reports 27B nominal active language-model parameters; this excludes an asserted all-modality/MTP execution total. Native context is 262,144 tokens; extension to 1,000,000 is documented.

summary: Confirmed exact August 14 release, open weights, context and multimodal/reasoning/tool capabilities. Added Apache-2.0 license and dense architecture. Replaced name-derived 27B with verified complete checkpoint count 27.781427952B, distinguishing nominal language-model size from vision and MTP components. Parent review found 27B nominal active language-model parameters explicitly disclosed in a later official comparison table; no unresolved verification failures.
